notes.title: Deck of Souls is now out in full release!
notes.content:
Greetings!

We are thrilled to announce that Deck of Souls is now complete and officially launching today!

[previewyoutube=lfhixwjhGa8;full][/previewyoutube]

What's new in this update:
[list]
[*] Chapter 5, featuring the finale of the story.
[*] The ultimate boss, Satan.
[*] Five challenging sub-bosses.
[*] A new biome and enemies to conquer.
[/list]
We deeply appreciate everyone who has supported us throughout the game’s development. Your comments and feedback have been invaluable in making Deck of Souls more engaging and enjoyable for all players.

Play the game, share your thoughts, and don’t forget to leave a review on Steam!

Regards, 
Deck of Souls Team

notes.title: Added difficulty modifiers, new cards, and passives!
notes.content:
Greetings! 

Deck of Souls has a brand-new bumper update! We combined the second and fourth stages of our [url=https://store.steampowered.com/news/app/2088770/view/4209257868264101772]roadmap[/url] into one release.

We've listened to players and have implemented the option to change the card placed under an enemy. Now, the card will return to your hand and the spent stamina used to play it will be returned accordingly. However, you can only do this three times per battle, so choose wisely.

Here's what else is new in the latest update: 
[list]
[*] Added difficulty modifiers, which players will unlock by completing the third act.
[*] Added the ability to permanently improve the hero's stats between runs. This option will become available at level 5. If you have already reached this level, you will need to replay it to unlock the new feature. 
[*] Added 3 new cards. 
[*] Added 3 new passives. 
[/list]
Play Deck of Souls and let us know what you think. 

Thanks to everyone who supports Deck of Souls! It keeps us motivated to keep working on the game! 

Regards,
Deck of Souls Team

notes.title: Play the first Early Access update for Deck of Souls!
notes.content:
Greetings! 

We've implemented all of the changes and we're finally ready to unveil the first Early Access update for Deck of Souls!

What's new: 
[list]
[*] Three new enemies in the city;
[*] Two new backgrounds – with visual effects – for the city;
[*] Five new relics. 
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42683012/690df6c6df7dd175b4314fd3c92ebf911bda7e58.png[/img]

We have also prepared a number of QoL improvements based on your feedback:
[list]
[*] Provided clarity on the order in which cards are played. We hope there will be no more issues with this. 
[*] Accelerated animations. You can now select the speed in the game settings.
[*] Added description of the conditions to unlock new classes.
[*] Removed the need to select a class after finishing the tutorial. 
[*] It is now clear which items can and cannot be upgraded..
[*] Updated the localization for several languages.
[*] And several other changes.
[/list]

Download the updated version, share your feedback with us here or on [url=https://discord.gg/ZhjKSKRFrh]Discord[/url], send the link to the game to your friends, and just have fun with it. 

Thank you to everyone who supports Deck of Souls, you help us to create the best game possible. 

Regards,
Deck of Souls Team

notes.title: Deck of Souls is out Early Access! See the roadmap!
notes.content:
Greetings! 

We're excited to announce that Deck of Souls is finally available in Early Access. Thank you to everyone who added the game to the Wishlist and supported us during the development. We hope you enjoy the game and have a lot of fun fighting the forces of Heaven and Hell. Your feedback and comments are very welcome – they will help us to continue making Deck of Souls better and more interesting. 

[previewyoutube=0-0eWh-Ov18;full][/previewyoutube]

Want to know what we'll add to the game before the full release? Check out our plans for the game's development time in Early Access. 

[h2][b]Early Access [/b][/h2]
Deck of Souls' Early Access will contain: 
[list]
[*] 3 hero classes: Holy Lich, Divine Knight, and Saint Talon – including numerous cards for each. There will be 77 cards for Holy Lich, 61 cards for Warrior, 64 cards for Saint Talon, and 32 neutral cards; 
[*] 3 incredible story chapters to replay over and over again;
[*] 3 deadly bosses, each with the challenging two-stage battles; 
[*] 3 different merchants;
[*] Unique items for each class, consisting of 28 items for the Holy Lich, 19 for the Saint Talon, 28 for the Warrior, 9 neutral items, and 7 relics; 
[*] 55 unique combat encounters, including bosses and random events; 
[*] 83 different nodes that treasure-filled glory or deadly combat encounters; 
[*] Over 140 different passives, but you'll have to play the game to uncover all of them!
[/list]
[h2][b]Update 1[/b][/h2]
We plan to add new hero equipment and enemies. We will also implement a number of QoL improvements based on feedback from players. 

[h2][b]Update 2[/b][/h2]
The most important changes in this update: 
[list]
[*] In-between-run upgrades: permanently improving hero stats, gaining new skills, and more.
[*] Run difficulty modifiers.
[*] New cards.
[*] New passives.
[/list]
[h2][b]Update 3[/b][/h2]
The following additions will become available:
[list]
[*] The fourth chapter of the story.
[*] New biome: the Castle. 
[*] A new boss.
[*] New random events.
[*] More enemies. 
[*] As well as two new sub-bosses.
[/list]
[h2][b]Update 4[/b][/h2]
While Deck of Souls is in Early Access, we'll read and consider all of the comments, reviews, and feedback from players. Feel free to share your ideas for the game with us, and we'll add the most relevant ones during this update.

In addition, we will add: 
[list]
[*] New events.
[*] New items.
[*] More QoL improvements.
[/list]
[h2][b]Update 5[/b][/h2]
In the final update, we'll release:
[list]
[*] Final chapter and end of story.
[*] Final boss.
[*] New biome: Hell.
[*] New enemies.   
[*] 4 new sub-bosses.
[/list]

Of course, at all stages, we will accept your bug reports and suggestions for improving the game. Share your thoughts and ideas with us in [url=https://discord.gg/dc75FEbaRM]Discord[/url] or Discussions on Steam.  

And now, choose a hero and go on a dangerous journey to meet angels, demons, villains, mages, and other inhabitants of the mysterious world of Deck of Souls. 

Regards,
Deck of Souls Team

notes.title: Devlog #2: Book of Souls, many changes to mechanics, and new cards
notes.content:
Greetings!

The development of Deck of Souls is well underway and progressing smoothly. The Book of Souls is almost complete and will show players an overview of their card collection and overall game progress.

We have also added brand new cards, a discard pile, starter decks for the Rogue and Warrior classes, and four new starter decks for the Caster class (bringing it up to six!).

And we have started work on improving the interface. If you have already played the Deck of Souls demo, we would love to hear your thoughts and ideas about the interface – it will greatly help us. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42683012/edde8d0b8bfe78443b8ec097e1768ca698e33e26.jpg[/img]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42683012/f0ef4702f51eb4ec403a616317768f08f0993188.png[/img]

There are also several changes to card mechanics:
[list]
[*] Stealth is now lost when dealing damage;
[*] Snack Attack makes the card instant when in stealth;
[*] Rush cards are now automatically applied if they are added to the deck and if the Rush value this turn allows it.
[*] You can no longer draw the same card twice. Once the deck is completely drawn, it will recharge from the discard pile. It's possible to have an empty deck and draw no cards.
[/list]
We've made the following additional changes:
[list]
[*] Added new cards;
[*] Cards now display the class they belong to;
[*] Added mechanics that enable players to discover and search for cards in the deck;
[*] An indicator to show player damage increases;
[*] Added effects for cards.
[/list]
Thank you for supporting Deck of Souls! Join our [url=https://discord.gg/fBSFex4YvT]Discord[/url] to share your impressions and chat with other players and the developer. 

Regards,
Deck of Souls Team

notes.title: Play the first demo of Deck of Souls!
notes.content:
Greetings!

We are proud to announce that you will be able to play the first demo of Deck of Souls during The Mix event on Steam. Join our hero on the quest of a lifetime!

The Deck of Souls demo will feature:
[list]
[*] The first full chapter of the story.
[*] 31 unique pieces of gear for your hero.
[*] Battle against 18 distinct enemies, 1 boss, and 3 sub-bosses.
[*] Encounter 22 varied traversal nodes that may involve combat, treasure, and more.
[*] One class, along with cards from two future classes to choose from.
[*] Over 150 different cards with different properties to diversify gameplay.
[/list]
We hope you will love the demo. Please be sure to share your impressions here, in the Steam discussions, or in our Discord – the more detailed your feedback, the more it'll help us to improve the game.

Regards,
Deck of Souls Team
